notes: Default apply_ready commits verified independent work in the initial instruction request with one version/history/receipt transaction. Explicit review and previously saved proposals retain confirmation compatibility.
Remaining text contains only pending clauses and original protections; the active plan history records completed execution text, with original_text preserved separately.
Coordinated subjects receive exact inherited material predicates with literal source_quote provenance. Only deterministic server expansions pass the service scope check.

Broad beauty goals authorize a bounded photographic attempt, not a claim that subjective quality is proven. The same final lighting values can serve both a general goal and an explicit lighting clause without repeated application.
All verified already-satisfied rows with pending work produce no_change plus partial metadata, without a fake version or preview. All-pending requests do not create an empty success.
Actual target/count/property verification, hard protections, source/catalog/metadata guards, idempotent retry, undo/replay and current-shot scope remain exercised.
UI uses one existing combined result panel. Pending reasons and completed changes are collapsed; no new persistent panels or forced new confirmation step were added.
Effective previous/next light values are calculated from the actual shot plan. Exact storage before/after values remain available for audit.
Planning and correction retain the two-call ceiling. No automatic provider/model upgrade was introduced; GPT-5.5 remains blocked.
Two original missing-fixture errors remain errors, not passes. Actual cabinet geometry and live provider recognition success remain outside this verification.
